properties.name: Ranch pin (Wilson family ranch)
properties.notes: T24S R8E sec. 17, Mount Diablo Meridian (BLM CadNSDI); ~150 m outside the current Fort Hunter Liggett boundary (US Census TIGERweb Military Installations).

properties.name: Bryson Post Office (Sapaque area)
properties.source: https://goldennuggetlibrary.sfgenealogy.org/po_mon.htm (Frickstad, A Century of California Post Offices 1848-1954); https://indexes.montereyhistory.org/sites/default/files/issues/1969/vol-13-num-1-march-1969.pdf (Noticias/Puerto de Monterey, Mar 1969); https://kids.kiddle.co/Bryson,_California; GNIS 252862 (Bryson populated place)
properties.notes: Coordinates are the GNIS point for the Bryson community, not a confirmed post-office building site (the office moved several times). Bryson was originally called Sapaque.

properties.name: Gem Post Office
properties.source: https://goldennuggetlibrary.sfgenealogy.org/po_mon.htm (Frickstad, A Century of California Post Offices 1848-1954); https://indexes.montereyhistory.org/sites/default/files/issues/1969/vol-13-num-1-march-1969.pdf (Noticias/Puerto de Monterey, Mar 1969)
properties.notes: "Located on top of the ridge between Pleyto and Bryson"; exact site unknown, so no coordinates.

properties.name: Lockwood Post Office
properties.source: https://goldennuggetlibrary.sfgenealogy.org/po_mon.htm (Frickstad, A Century of California Post Offices 1848-1954); https://lockwood.one-name.net/lockwood,ca.htm; GNIS 1660933
properties.notes: Named for Belva Ann Lockwood. The original townsite is mostly gone; the current PO is on the highway. Coordinates are the GNIS community point.

properties.name: Pleyto (Pleito) Post Office
properties.source: https://goldennuggetlibrary.sfgenealogy.org/po_mon.htm (Frickstad, A Century of California Post Offices 1848-1954); GNIS 1670149 Pleyto (historical); https://mchsmuseum.com/local-history/american-era-settlement/overview-of-post-hispanic-monterey-county-history/
properties.notes: The old Pleito site now lies under Lake San Antonio.

properties.name: Jolon Post Office
properties.dates: by 1878 in the Dutton (Dutton-Tidball) Hotel; Francis Sylvester petitioned in 1858
properties.notes: Coordinates are the GNIS point for Jolon village. Exact open/close dates not confirmed.

properties.name: San Antonio Post Office (Lowe's Station)
properties.source: https://goldennuggetlibrary.sfgenealogy.org/po_mon.htm (Frickstad, A Century of California Post Offices 1848-1954); MCHS overview
properties.notes: Stage stop at the east end of Jolon Valley; exact site not located.

properties.name: Nasimento / Veratina Post Office
properties.dates: Nasimento 1887-12-03; renamed Veratina 1888-11-07; closed 1895-07-11 (mail to Bradley)
properties.source: https://goldennuggetlibrary.sfgenealogy.org/po_mon.htm (Frickstad, A Century of California Post Offices 1848-1954); https://indexes.montereyhistory.org/sites/default/files/issues/1969/vol-13-num-1-march-1969.pdf (Noticias/Puerto de Monterey, Mar 1969)

properties.name: Botts quicksilver mine (Bryson Mine / Botts deposit)
properties.dates: produced to 1940; owner Victor Botts in 1941 (8-pipe retort, 1941)
properties.notes: Cinnabar in sandstone on a NE-trending fault; SE1/4 sec. 7 T24S R8E, south side of Sycamore Creek; now inside Fort Hunter Liggett. The 1919 USGS Bryson topo labels a "QUICKSILVER MINE" here.

properties.name: Bryson Mine (quicksilver)
properties.notes: Sec. 7 T24S R8E. Location is only to the section centre (+/-1 km). It may be the same workings as Botts (MRDS lists "Bryson Mine" as an alias).

properties.name: S. P. Dayton Ranch gold placer
properties.source: https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/show-mrds.php?dep_id=10165466 ; Calif. Jour. Mines & Geol. v.31 (1935) p.423
properties.notes: Placer gold occurrence; location accuracy +/-1 km; San Luis Obispo County.

properties.name: Polar Star quicksilver mine
properties.notes: Nearest group of Santa Lucia quicksilver mines to the SW.

properties.name: Pine Mountain / Buckeye / Little Almaden quicksilver mines
properties.notes: Cluster of mercury mines to the south.

properties.name: Klau / Buena Vista quicksilver mines
properties.notes: Major mercury mines west of Paso Robles.

properties.name: Los Burros gold mine (Los Burros district)
properties.notes: Los Burros Mining District, near the coast ridge.

properties.name: Manchester townsite / Last Chance (Buclimo) gold mine area
properties.dates: town c.1875-1895; Last Chance lode found 1887 by W. D. Cruikshank; produced about $62,000
properties.notes: Coordinates are the Manchester townsite. The Last Chance mine was "at the head of Alder Creek"; it is not in MRDS, so its exact point is unknown.
